# FDG7021

> DO ensure that each sentence of the message text ends with a period.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.2.1 Error Message Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG7021
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Message: End the exception message with a period

Test profile: none, because exception messages that test code creates for test doubles are not shown to users. FDG7021 reports a string literal, or an interpolated string that ends with text, passed to a parameter named message of the constructor of a type derived from System.Exception, when its trimmed text does not end with a period; a message that ends with a question mark or an exclamation point is left to FDG7022. Messages built at run time (concatenation, string.Format, resources, an interpolation that ends with a value) are not checked, so coverage is partial, and only the last sentence is checked. There is no code fix.

## From the book

This way, code that displays exception messages to the user does not have to handle the case in which a developer forgot the final period, which is relatively cumbersome and expensive.
